info.title: WIS WhatsApp API
info.description: Local SQLite API for one WIS connection wis-5679. Bearer tokens have explicit scopes. Admin cookies and same-origin Origin are required for administration. Sends and webhook delivery are disabled by default. Live dashboard pagination preserves data arrays and adds top-level meta. Snapshots are observed data, never a claim of complete WhatsApp history. Sync queues read-only work and does not activate outbound.
